node.title: Re: print() on closed filehandle WRITE_FH
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: [doc://select] changes the default output for [doc://print] statements, and you've got some [doc://print] statements after you [doc://close] WRITE_FH that are then still trying to write to the file. You need to save the original output handle by first saying my $orig_fh = select(WRITE_FH); and then restore it later by saying select($orig_fh); right before or after you [doc://close] the file.
